items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: we’ve heard that they were in White Russia – her mother. Betsy. Her mother.

ctx.x: Your mother was a pianist. Were there other musicians in her family?

No. Not that I know of. That family you mentioned being Polish, trying to trace them, we’ve heard that they were in White Russia – her mother. Betsy. Her mother. Then into Poland, and from Poland to Germany, and from Germany she got a way to get to California as a nanny or a servant to the Gangerer – I don’t know how to spell it. Capital G – Iola would know. Then she married Henry Ivy.
When you were in first grade, I believe you were . . .
